lines.en: Every muscle in my body ached as though I'd been beaten black and blue.
The consciousness I'd briefly lost returned, and I opened my eyes in a pitch-black void, vomiting Stories.
There was nothing to see around me. But I knew where I was.
[‘The Indescribable Distance’ casts a glance at you.]
‘The Indescribable Distance’, the Nameless Mist (The nameless mist).
I'd encountered an avatar of this being in the 73rd Demon Realm.
A being that had annihilated my Demon Realm and brought down Narrative-grade constellations and transcendents with nothing more than its avatar's power.
I was inside the maw of a disaster I'd never wanted to face again.
「Kim Dokja thought. This is the only way to stop the Apocalypse Dragon.」
······Right. I'd wondered why you were keeping quiet.
「Summon another disaster to stop the world's disaster. It was the sort of idea only someone like the regressor Yoo Joonghyuk would have.」
I smiled bitterly at the [Fourth Wall]'s messages appearing in the air.
「Even so, Kim Dokja had to do this.」
The effects of the backlash flowing around me still lingered.
―You've distorted far too much probability.
―At this rate, the karma of the probability you've built up will explode soon. You know what that means?
This was the karmic debt of probability I'd accumulated all this time.
The very debt the constellations had warned me about, the one the dokkaebis had spoken of.
「There is no Story in which nothing precious is lost.」
All the great Stories of <Star Stream> were Stories of loss.
Heroes sacrificed something to awaken, and love and friendship could only be complete when one of the two lovers or friends was lost.
A being lost something, and through that loss, a Story was completed.
「Kim Dokja hated that.」
I'd thought that someday, I would pay the price for losing nothing.
That the time would come to pay for twisting stories and distorting probability.
「So Kim Dokja decided to use it.」
Tsssss!
Lumps of Story spilled from my mouth.

It wasn't only because The Indescribable Distance was attacking me. What attacked me was distorted probability. The distortions of the world I'd accumulated to summon an Outer God were trying to exclude me from the scenario.
[Story ‘Demon King of Salvation’ continues its story.]
The Stories were the reason I could endure.
Stories whispering their tales in my ears.
You are the Demon King of Salvation. You must save people.
The Stories were speaking to me, just as they had to Metatron and Agares.
[Story ‘King of a Kingless World’ continues its storytelling.]
[Giant Story ‘Demon Realm's Spring’ continues its storytelling.]
[Giant Story ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’ continues its storytelling.]
Within the trembling dark mist, I could sense the scene outside.
[‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation’ reveals hostility toward ‘The Indescribable Distance’!]
[‘The Indescribable Distance’ moves.]
Fortunately, everything was going according to plan.
The Outer God had come to devour me, then discovered more appetizing prey. Now it was wholly intent on the ‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation’.
The battle between two disasters was beginning.
The Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation versus the Nameless Mist.
Their mutual destruction would offer hope to everyone else.
What mattered was buying time.
Buying time for the constellations to gather again, for those damned stars to form a constellation once more, as befitted their name.
[Your incarnation body has sustained severe damage!]
[The Status of a distant being eats away at the ‘context of your modifier’.]
[The bonds between your Stories loosen.]
[<Star Stream> is astonished by your wondrous achievement.]
[A Giant Story for you is awakening.]
Something like a faint song reached me from far away.
A melody I'd heard long ago. I didn't know whether it had belonged to my mother, my companions, or someone else.
But as I listened to that faint song, I
[Story ‘Life and Death Companions’ continues its story.]
thought that I didn't want to die.
Rrrrrumble!
Worlds were colliding. Pitch-black mist enveloped Kim Dokja, who had been exposed head-on to the Apocalypse Dragon's shockwave.
Now that terrible Outer God was bearing the shockwave in Kim Dokja's place.
As the two powers born of Chaos clashed, everything around them was sucked into the void.
[Constellation ‘Mandala’s Guardian’ gives a low, thoughtful hum.]
Fortunately, the point of collision was farther away than expected, and the companions on the ground were safe.
Most of the constellations' faces had gone ashen after seeing the Apocalypse Dragon and then even an Outer God.
As though their years of ruling the heavens had been a lie, disasters that even Narrative-grade constellations couldn't withstand were waging war.
Only then did the constellations of the night sky fully realize it.
The world's end truly was upon them.
But to some, the sacrifice of a single person was a greater tragedy than the end of the world.
“Ajusshiiii―!”
With a desperate shout, Lee Jihye fired a barrage at the dark mist. Of course, her gunfire did no harm to the Nameless Mist's true body. A foe whose body had no discernible beginning or end.
But the companions couldn't control their raging emotions.
“No, no, no!”
Shin Yoosung cried out convulsively, as though afflicted with a disease that made her repeat the same words. As if sharing her feelings, the Chimera Dragon fired its breath into the air.
Beside her, Lee Gilyoung's eyes had partly lost focus. An ominous demonic energy seeped from the trembling boy's whole body.
“The contract······ I'll make it······ I won't······ I will······.”

Three others stepped out in front of them. Faced with the worst disaster they could imagine, the companions all went mad in different ways. Some lost their reason to the emotions flooding them, while others held on to theirs, broken with exquisite precision.
Yoo Joonghyuk, his Transcendent Form released.
Han Sooyoung, wrapped in the Black Flame Dragon.
Jung Heewon, who had opened her eyes of God Slaying (神殺).
Before anyone could stop them, all three stepped forward at once and looked at one another. Then someone blocked their path.
It was Anna Croft.
“Stop, all of you! You mustn't leave the battlefield!”
[Nebula <Asgard> takes control of the battlefield.]
At Anna Croft's voice, <Asgard>'s Giant Story pinned the three in place. Yoo Joonghyuk's expression twisted.
“Get lost.”
“This isn't what the Demon King of Salvation wants!”
“‘What the Demon King of Salvation wants’?”
As though there was no need to hear any more, black flames gathered in Han Sooyoung's left hand.
Anna Croft said,
“I'm beginning to see glimpses of the future.”
Stories flowed through her [Great Demon's Eyes].
“It means he may have done it.”
Anna Croft seemed sincerely awed.
Watching the fierce battle between the two disasters in the distant sky, she spoke.
“He truly means to save this world······.”
“Fuck! The end of the world isn't what matters. We―”
“His sacrifice is noble. Do you truly not understand what it means?”
“Will you shut your fucking mouth?”
Han Sooyoung exploded at her. Faced with that terrifying wave of energy, even Anna Croft fell silent for a moment.
“Why should Kim Dokja save the world? Why should that bastard sacrifice his life for this bullshit? Is a world like this worth it?”

Han Sooyoung's voice was heated. The voice of someone who had held back her anger, held it back, then held it back again. Seeing her face and hearing those words, the Prophet recalled something she'd heard long ago.
“The Demon King of Salvation once said exactly the same thing as you.”
―We'll have to wait and see whether this world is worth protecting.
Perhaps it had been at the Gourmet Association. The Demon King of Salvation had said something like that, too.
Anna Croft understood what those words meant.
This world was ruled by dokkaebis and constellations. She, too, had founded ‘Zarathustra’ to change such a world.
Anna Croft looked up at the sky again.
The Prophet couldn't know whether the Demon King of Salvation was still questioning the world even now. Only,
“And now he is up there.”
Some Stories were proven through deeds rather than words.
“Wasn't it in this world that you met one another?”
At those words, for the first time, the three wore the same expression.
Anna Croft continued carefully.
“Trust me as a Prophet. You need to conserve your strength. We must seize the moment when the two disasters destroy one another. Only then can we all survive.”
“A Prophet? You think you're the only one who knows the future?”
Only then did Anna Croft realize something.
The Story of [Predictive Plagiarism] flowed around Han Sooyoung. The regressor Yoo Joonghyuk, too, was constantly reading the situation through [Sage's Eye].
A Prophet wasn't the only one who could predict the future. They, too, possessed insight into it that surpassed anyone else's.
Even so, they had chosen to save Kim Dokja.
Drawing her sword, Jung Heewon said,
“I don't know anything about the future. But I know one thing. You said you wanted to save the world, right? So do I.”
Her resolve sent pure white flames pouring from the [Sword of Judgement].
“He is the world I want to save.”
With those words, all three leaped into the air. Neither the probability of a Giant Story nor the oppression of a nebula could stop them.
Anna Croft reached out urgently, but they were already soaring skyward.
What stopped them was neither a nebula nor probability.
Han Sooyoung was the first to notice ‘it’.
“What? Fucking―”
Rrrrrumble!
The battle to the death between the two disasters was throwing the sky out of balance.
The problem was that the weight of that collapsing balance was tipping toward them.
[That is······.]

One of the constellations murmured. Something was writhing and splitting within the dark mist covering the sky. As if pressing the Apocalypse Dragon weren't enough, ‘The Indescribable Distance’, the Nameless Mist, had begun making avatars of itself.
“Ah, aaah. Aaaaah······.”
Bright yellow eyes of terror, visible through the dark mist. Shin Yoosung's shoulders trembled as though an old nightmare had returned.
Shin Yoosung had seen those eyes before. Every incarnation who saw them lost their sanity and became an otherworldly creature.
That day, everyone in the [Industrial Complex] had been utterly powerless before that disaster.
But someone remembered that day very differently.
[It's a little smaller than it was then.]
It was Cheok Jungyeong.
Cheok Jungyeong drew his sword and stepped forward. The Stories he'd honed on ‘Reincarnation Island’ writhed like muscles around his body.
[Let's go, little transcendent.]
Kyrgios climbed onto Cheok Jungyeong's shoulder. The two had coordinated against ‘The Indescribable Distance’ before.
As Cheok Jungyeong leaped into the air, Kyrgios's [Electrification] flowed over his sword.
A brilliant White Pure current enveloped Cheok Jungyeong, and he flashed like a god of lightning.
[I, Cheok Jungyeong, have waited for this day alone!]
His bold Status blazed forth.
Before him stood an enemy his sword had failed to cut, though it had cut mountains and seas.
For this moment alone, he'd trained his unfinished fourth sword form (四劒). He'd spent all that time creating a single sword form to oppose that immeasurable, boundless void.
And this was the result.
Cheok Jungyeong's tightly compressed Stories ignited, and Kyrgios's lightning spun fiercely around him.
The constellations on the ground looked up.
One constellation and one transcendent.
As though finding their combined Status laughable, the avatar of ‘The Indescribable Distance’ opened its mouth at them. Just as the maw of dark mist was about to swallow the starlight,
The Fourth Form (四式).
Cheok Jungyeong's sword shone.
Fourth Sword that Beheads the Emptiness (四劍斬虛).
The heart of the mist began to split slowly. Something spilled from its center, as though a beast's belly had been slit open.
The yellow eye bulging from the dark mist began to crumble, vomiting Stories.
[Many constellations cannot take their eyes off the martial prowess of ‘Goryeo’s First Sword’!]
[Many constellations gape at the unbelievable sight!]
Every constellation on the ground was astonished.
Avatar or not, the opponent was ‘The Indescribable Distance’. <Star Stream>'s cleaner, a disaster that devoured distorted probability.
Cheok Jungyeong had cut down that disaster, said to be beyond anyone's ability to fight.
No one had even properly seen the form of his sword technique.
Only Yoo Joonghyuk recognized it.
Even Yoo Joonghyuk, who had cut a star, looked astonished at that moment.
“Will-Form Sword (意形劍)······.”
The power to cut the world through will alone. The highest realm one could attain through martial arts. Only after becoming a constellation had Cheok Jungyeong reached those lofty heights.
[There is nothing my sword cannot cut!]
Watching the mist scatter helplessly in the bursting light, Cheok Jungyeong felt liberated, too.
How long had he endured to cut that thing?

The ecstasy of reaching the realm of Thoughtlessness (無想), when his own will became his sword. His fourth sword form, ‘Fourth Sword that Beheads the Emptiness’, was the quintessence of the martial arts he'd comprehended. Looking toward Yoo Joonghyuk, he shouted,
[Go, successors! Go to Kim Dokja―]
But Cheok Jungyeong couldn't finish. A tremendous impact from behind wrecked his entire incarnation body.
Cheok Jungyeong plummeted like a meteor and slammed into the ground.
When he barely managed to look up through the shaking surroundings, he realized what had happened. Someone murmured,
[My god······ <Star Stream> is going to end.]
It made no sense.
Cheok Jungyeong felt his incarnation body tremble.
I just cut it down.
As though what had just happened were a joke, a huge eye looked down at him from the sky.
There was more than one avatar.
Enough avatars to cover the entire sky. What looked like dozens of avatars of ‘The Indescribable Distance’ were descending to devour the living things on the ground.
[Aaaaaaah!]
Terrified Historical-grade constellations fled beyond the horizon. But disaster was coming from that direction, too.
Crrrrack!

Teeth growing from the mist crushed constellations' incarnation bodies like tender fruit. There was nowhere to hide or run. It was better than facing the Apocalypse Dragon's shockwave, but every bit as hopeless.
[Everyone, stay calm! You just saw it! We can fight them!]
Dionysus shouted himself hoarse, but the constellations didn't rally.
[Damn it······.]

Having spent considerable Status enduring the first two shockwaves, <Olympus>'s constellations couldn't fight at full strength. The <Underworld>, too, was steadying its Stories after consuming too much probability. Uriel and the Black Flame Dragon were doing better than most.
“Get lost! Get the fuck away, you bastards!”
Yoo Joonghyuk, Han Sooyoung, and Jung Heewon stood back to back, releasing their Status.

They planned to hold off the advancing dark mist and throw themselves toward where Kim Dokja had vanished as soon as an opening appeared. But no opening came. At this rate, they would all be wiped out before they could save him.
“Damn it! Isn't there anyone else? Doesn't Kim Dokja have any more friends?”
But however hard they thought, no one who could help came to mind.
The Black Flame Dragon's Status and Uriel's were dwindling little by little.
[Constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ glares at ‘Scribe of Heaven’.]
[Constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ says he still cannot use the ‘Right Hand of Destructive Void’······.]
The dark mist covering Reincarnation Island had now finished warming up to swallow the island.
That was when something like car headlights shone in the distance.
With a screech, something broke through the smoke and arrived.
The car emerging from the pale dust was familiar to <Kim Dokja’s Company>.
[Hmm. It would be troublesome if you got hurt here. You still have three more advertisements to film.]

The [X-grade Ferrarghini]'s door opened, and a middle-aged man with graying hair waved cheerfully. A pink polo shirt with a pineapple on it and ripped jeans. At that astonishing fashion sense, so out of place on a battlefield, Han Sooyoung's mouth fell open.
“······Mass Production Maker?”
A few constellations fighting the disaster nearby murmured,
[Mass Production Maker? Is he a powerful constellation?]
[No, he's an old man who won't be much help.]
[I think I've heard of him. Blinded by coins, churning out trashy Stories······.]
Han Sooyoung looked at that ‘Mass Production Maker’.
Mass Production Maker was a Narrative-grade constellation. But the Status she felt from him wasn't particularly strong for his grade.
Mass Production Maker chuckled good-naturedly.
[Haha, it seems I don't inspire much confidence.]
At that easygoing remark, Thor shouted as he poured wine into his mouth.
[Hey, Steady Person! Since you're here, hurry up and lend a hand! We're desperate enough to need even an old man's help!]
[Hmm, I haven't come to fight.]
[Then why are you here?]
[To contribute a few coins.]
[You crazy old man······ How the hell is that supposed to help now?]
The constellations shouted, unable to contain their anger.
[If that's all you have to say, get lost! You coin-blinded old man······!]
But Mass Production Maker showed no sign of being cowed.
Suddenly, Han Sooyoung remembered a conversation she'd once had with Kim Dokja.
Watching ‘Mass Production Maker’ talk to the dokkaebis beyond the recording studio, she'd asked,
―Kim Dokja. What's with that constellation? He doesn't look that strong······ Why are the dokkaebis groveling?
Kim Dokja had answered as though it were obvious.
―He has a lot of coins.
Now, Mass Production Maker was smiling just as Kim Dokja had then.
[I don't understand you young people. Why do you dismiss coins?]
[They're just consumables―]
With a whir, a coin appeared, spinning above Mass Production Maker's palm. One coin.
[Look closely. Does this really look like a mere ‘consumable’? Have you never wondered why <Star Stream> goes out of its way to use these ‘coins’ as its unit of exchange?]
[What bullshit are you trying to spout?]
Looking at the avatars that had now come right up to them, Mass Production Maker spoke.
[I'll give you a hint. Everything in <Star Stream> is made of ‘Stories’. What, then, do you suppose ‘coins’ are?]
[······Have you gone senile? We're busy, so stop talking to us!]
As though such nonsense wasn't worth hearing, the constellations busied themselves blasting magic power into the air.
But even in that desperate situation, Han Sooyoung listened.
And she got goosebumps.
It was exactly as Mass Production Maker said. Everything in <Star Stream> was a Story.
Then why was <Star Stream>'s unit of exchange ‘coins’ rather than ‘Stories’?
Tsssss!
An enormous amount of probability was gathering around Mass Production Maker.
And under its influence, his Status was being amplified.
In an instant, his Status surpassed Historical-grade, then Narrative-grade.
Startled by that tremendous amplification of Status, the constellations of Good and Evil turned toward Mass Production Maker at once.
[A very old Story begins its storytelling.]
Mass Production Maker. He, too, was a constellation pursuing ‘A Single Story’ of his own.
Then what ■■ did he pursue?
[What rules the world is neither good nor evil. It is capital (資本).]
Mass Production Maker tossed the coin high into the sky.
Yoo Joonghyuk, Han Sooyoung, and Jung Heewon all saw it.
But none of them saw what amount was written on that coin.
[And I have more coins than anyone else in <Star Stream>.]
More precisely, they felt they could believe any amount written on it.
Just how many coins would he have to spend to perform such a miracle with them?
[Someone has spent a large quantity of coins!]
[Story ‘Golden Omnipotence (黃金萬能主義)’ begins its storytelling!]
A moment later, a roar rang out from the sky where the coin had vanished. With a cracking sound, a swirling door opened. A gate.
[A one-way gate has been created!]
A single constellation had opened a gate that only dokkaebis and the Bureau could open.
[<Star Stream>'s Bureau, the probability of this Story······.]
[Summoning begins!]
Human figures (人形) were faintly visible beyond the gate.
Looking as relaxed as though he'd come on vacation, ‘Mass Production Maker’ shrugged.
[Oh, there is one thing you're right about. I'm not much of a fighter.]
Dazzling light burst from beyond the gate.
As though he'd expected it, Mass Production Maker took out a pair of sunglasses, put them on, and continued.
[But I can use this to bring friends who are.]
Those being summoned through the gate onto the battlefield.
Yoo Joonghyuk was the first to recognize them.
“······Master?”
The Breaking the Sky Sword Saint and transcendents flew through the gate.
Apart from the Sword Saint, some of the transcendents were familiar faces.
One Invincible Fist, Yoo Hoseong.

The strongest being on ‘Reincarnation Island’ had also joined the battle to help with this scenario. It seemed the Sword Saint had arrived late because she'd been persuading them. But Yoo Joonghyuk's expression didn't improve.
······Could they stop it by themselves?

There were dozens of avatars of a disaster that even Narrative-grade constellations couldn't withstand. However strong the Sword Saint and Yoo Hoseong were, this wasn't an enemy transcendents alone could handle.
But there was one more familiar face at the back of the group of transcendents.
“Holy shit, you should've let me come like this sooner!”
It was Jang Hayoung.
Several companions shouted her name.
Jang Hayoung smiled a little shyly and waved back.
“Sorry I'm so late! I had to persuade someone.”
······Persuade?
Jang Hayoung couldn't continue.
At the appearance of new powerful opponents, a large number of avatars of ‘The Indescribable Distance’ had changed direction.
Jang Hayoung's expression, too, grew tense as she watched the Outer God approach.
She'd seen them in the Demon Realm. And she knew very well that, as she was now, she couldn't handle even one avatar.
At least, not with her own strength alone.
The next moment, a golden aura exploded from Jang Hayoung's body.
An immense Status was being released with her body at its center.
Jang Hayoung's blond hair spread in waves, and a small golden band grew across her pale forehead. A beautiful golden fur coat covered her whole body like a second skin.
As she slowly opened her eyes, the uncanny energy of Fiery Golden Eyes (火眼金睛) swirled within them.
[Constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ narrows his eyes.]
[Constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is startled.]
[Constellation ‘Goryeo’s First Sword’ sighs.]
[All constellations of the Neutral faction are astonished!]
Everyone there recognized that Status. They couldn't fail to.
In Jang Hayoung's hand, extended into the air, rested the heaviest staff in the world.
As those boundlessly arrogant, lofty eyes gazed at the heavens, every cloud in the world trembled at once.
[Go and save Kim Dokja.]
The speaker wasn't Jang Hayoung.
[Constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ has manifested in the scenario!]
While exploring ‘Reincarnation Island’, Jang Hayoung had used the ‘Unidentifiable Wall’ several times. Using its first-stage function, the ‘Chat System’, she'd tried talking to constellations.
―Demon King of Salvation-nim.
―······Why are you calling me that?
At some point, she'd even grown brazen enough to talk to Kim Dokja quite freely.
For a while, she'd even suffered a split in her sense of self, wanting to deny the ‘Demon King of Salvation = Kim Dokja’ theory. But now she had no choice but to accept it.

The Demon King of Salvation whom Jang Hayoung liked was Kim Dokja, and that idiot Kim Dokja was the Demon King of Salvation. She'd barely managed to accept that fact. Of course, she hadn't accepted it all.
―I'm speaking to the Demon King of Salvation-nim, so Kim Dokja, please don't answer.
―I can't help it. Shut up and give me only the answers I want.
―······What answers am I supposed to give?
When Kim Dokja actually asked her that, the sorrow she'd kept bottled up burst out.
―Why won't you let me into ‘Kim Dokja’s Company’?

It was something she'd always wanted to ask. As all the companions moved on to the next scenario through ‘Context of the Constellations’, Jang Hayoung had been left behind with her masters, backstage in the scenario. She'd wanted to go with them. To be one of those constellations herself.
Was it because I wasn't qualified?
Because I hadn't been with Kim Dokja in the scenarios from the beginning.

Jang Hayoung remembered all the time they'd spent carrying out a revolution in the Demon Realm and surviving the Demon King Selection. It was the first exhilaration she'd experienced in her life, and now it was part of who she was.
So she'd thought she was Kim Dokja's companion now, too. But perhaps that had only been her own misunderstanding.
―I want you to live a free life.
At his reply, anger surged in Jang Hayoung's chest.
She wanted to demand what kind of bullshit he was spouting now, after all this. But
―Being forced into another dimension, living in the Demon Realm—none of that was your choice.
She couldn't argue. As though she'd stopped breathing, all she could do was read the messages that followed.
―Live the life you want, Hayoung-ah.
Those were the words of the ‘Demon King of Salvation’.
The words of that lofty constellation, intoxicated by Stories of saving others, neglecting even his own life.
Which was why they weren't the words of Jang Hayoung's friend, ‘Kim Dokja’.
「His words do not reach her.」
The ‘Unidentifiable Wall’ was speaking. Even with this wall, which allowed instant communication with any being in the world, she couldn't hear Kim Dokja's voice.
Just as she'd asked, he was nothing but the ‘Demon King of Salvation’.
‘No, if you say it like that, what am I supposed to do?’
That was why Jang Hayoung wanted to hear Kim Dokja's voice.
[‘Unidentifiable Wall’ gains its own name!]
That was what had brought her here now.
[‘Unidentifiable Wall’ evolves into ‘Wall of Impossible Communication’!]
[The second-stage function of ‘Wall of Impossible Communication’ is unlocked!]
She'd unlocked the new wall's power, persuaded a constellation who could help <Kim Dokja’s Company>, and come all the way here.
To live the life she wanted, not the one anyone else wanted for her.
Tssssss!
She saw the dumbfounded faces of <Kim Dokja’s Company> staring at her. As the rising Status made her head swim, Jang Hayoung shouted,
“Pull yourselves together and get moving! I can't hold out that long!”
She shouted, feeling her consciousness gradually fade.
The constellation's presence was taking over Jang Hayoung's incarnation body.
[‘Wall of Impossible Communication’ is activating ‘Impossible Longing Lv.1’!]
Impossible Longing. A power of the ‘Wall of Impossible Communication’ that allowed Jang Hayoung, who had no constellation sponsor, to enter a temporary ‘sponsorship contract’ with someone.
[Constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ looks down at his incarnation body.]
‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’, Sun Wukong, the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal.
According to Kim Dokja, one of the strongest constellations in <Star Stream>.
That great constellation swept his arrogant gaze over the world, then spoke in a lofty voice.
[Now that I'm actually out here, it's such a bother.]
An incredulous Jang Hayoung yelled,
“Hey, you said you'd help! Didn't I listen to your troubles, too? Hurry up and move!”
It was absurd as far as Jang Hayoung was concerned, but it wasn't as though she couldn't understand him. The Great Sage manifested in her body had been strange from the start.
Tzzzz.
His presence was unstable, as though several beings had temporarily become ‘one’. Perhaps the ‘bother’ he'd mentioned had something to do with that phenomenon. But that was his problem.
“If you don't keep your promise right now, your hair······!”
[I will. I said I will!]
Complaining, the Great Sage gripped his Ruyi Jingu Bang once more.
The Status flowing from his body drew the curiosity of several constellations.
[Great Sage. Sending them up there now is suicide. Even you―]
[Who are you?]
[······I am Cheok Jungyeong.]
As though standing against the Great Sage's Status, Cheok Jungyeong puffed out his chest. The Great Sage quietly read the emotions in his eyes, then asked,
[Do you know Master Sun?]
It took Cheok Jungyeong a moment to realize that ‘Master Sun’ meant the Great Sage himself.
[I know you were once a renowned constellation. But―]
[True, it has been too long since I properly took part in the scenarios.]
Yawning, the Great Sage shrank his Ruyi Jingu Bang and picked his ear with it.
Just as Cheok Jungyeong was about to flare up at his arrogance,
[Constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ releases his Status!]
The incarnation bodies of Cheok Jungyeong and the other constellations flew into the air. Cheok Jungyeong's eyes widened in surprise.
A presence that cowed the surrounding constellations merely by releasing its Status.
[The sparks······!]

Some of the constellations cried out, shuddering. Jang Hayoung's body, in which the Great Sage had manifested, was covered in tremendous sparks. It wasn't unusual for probability sparks to occur when constellations released their Status.
The problem was that this was Scenario 89's region. Sparks so dazzling, in a region that could accommodate almost any amount of probability······.
[Watch.]
A field of the Eight Trigrams spread in all four directions around the Great Sage.
Geon (乾)·Tae (兌)·I (離)·Jin (震)·Son (巽)·Gam (坎)·Gan (艮)·Gon (坤).
The characters spun fiercely around the Great Sage's Ruyi Jingu Bang (如意金箍棒), pouring out torrents of golden light.
Sensing his power, avatars of ‘The Indescribable Distance’ surged toward him.
Tsssss!
Probability sparks were a precursor to backlash. Like predators lunging at tempting prey, the avatars opened their maws toward the Great Sage. Five or six were charging him.
It was a force that even a Myth-grade constellation, let alone a Narrative-grade one, would struggle to face.
But the Great Sage didn't retreat.
The moment the boundless dark mist covered his entire body, he turned into a golden flash. With a raging vortex, Ruyi Jingu Bang pierced the maw of dark mist.
Rrrrrumble······!
